w: Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of murtis for a BAPS hari mandir in Bedford, Pennsylvania at the Edison Mandir.

The evening assembly was dedicated as Children’s Day program which included traditional dances based on the theme, “Swami Bapa, We Love You Forever.” Swamishri underscored the importance of instilling values and faith in children in his blessings. Then Congressman Frank Pallone addressed the assembly, “It reminds me how important education is and how important it is to serve as an example for your children. Sanskrit and Hindu scriptures are so important that we should all live by…”
ph: Balaks joyously dance next to Swamishri
Swamishri attentively listens to a young child

w: Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of the shikharbaddh BAPS Swaminarayan Mandir in the morning and thereafter blessed the pratishtha assembly. For details see pp. 4-11.

At 5.07 in the evening, Brahmvatsaldas Swami told Mahant Swami Maharaj a message from the sadhus organising the assembly for today's tenth anniversary celebration of the Yuva Talim Kendra (youth training centre): "Right now the sun is very strong and there is hardly any wind, and we are about to start seating everyone. So if you show compassion, the wind will start, clouds will come and it will become cool, and everyone will enjoy this celebration."
Stopping his letter writing, Swamishri did a dhun. Immediately news came that "the wind has started, just as we wanted."
Nishkulanand Swami has written in the Bhaktachintamani:
"The moon, the sun, Shesh and the ocean all remain under my command,
Water, earth, fire and wind are afraid in their minds..."
Everyone felt that the switch for the wind is in Swamishri's hands.
